description: Visa rules for every country of a route in one call, for up to 10 passports at once, plus the tightest leg of the route.

countries.description: Countries in travel order, comma separated ISO alpha-2 codes or slugs, up to 12, e.g. RU,GE,TR.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

passports.description: Passports to answer for, comma separated, up to 10, e.g. RU,BY.

weight.description: Vehicle weight class for the vehicle rules.

name: get_route_visa_rules
title: Visa Rules For A Route
